main_text.p: dinum, exempli gratia, definitio lineæ, trianguli quadranguli, &c.

Postulata siue Ætemata sunt talia principia, quæ negari aut conuelli neque possunt nec debent; interim tamen vt tanto rectius Geometra doceat, petit & postulat ea sibi à discipulo seu auditore concedi.
Et hæc postulata Geometrica sunt quatuor:
Primum Postulatum est: A quouis puncto in quoduis punctum lineam ducere.f.

p.i: f. Punctum, vt Pythagoreis placet, est vnitas quæ situm obtinet. Vnitas vero punctum est, quod situ vacat.

main_text.p: Secundum Postulat.est; Rectam lineam terminatam continuo perducere quoufque velis.
Tertium Postulatum est: Ex quouis centro & interuallo circulum producere.
Quartum Postulatum est: Quacunque magnitudine data sumi posse aliam vel maiorem vel minorem.
Id est. Nunquam potest dari quantitas tam magna, quæ maior fieri nō possit, &nunq̃ quantitas tam parua, quæ

page.notes: Diagrams I, II and III are line figures with points labelled α, β, γ, δ, ε; they are not transcribed as text. Catchword "quæ" at the lower right of the last line is treated as a catchword. The figure "3" at the right margin beside diagram III is a printed number and is uncertain. Italic note text is set in small type and is marked as a foot note.
